name: one-eval
description: Run isolated, repeatable evaluations and independently grade saved answers from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Prepare datasets, connect models or agents, verify execution isolation, run repeated evaluations, calibrate graders, and report saved results using the one-eval CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use one-eval to evaluate this API against my dataset with three repeats per case.
Use one-eval to grade saved answers with my rubric without rerunning the target.
Use one-eval to compare two saved evaluation runs and explain the differences.
